Welcome to the Zero to 1 series on investing & retiring early.
We’ll start from the basics, set up your first SIP, build your first portfolio, and finally make a retire early (FIRE) plan that fits your life.
If you don't know where to start, this series is for you.
All the resources shared in this series are free to use.
Investing Series Toolkit: open the sheet, click File → Make a copy, and fill it in along with us.
Use your own numbers, which will help you in making your own customized plan.
